sourceCaption:
Za’Darius Smith is bringing 45 people from his church on a Greyhound bus to the Falcons’ home opener ❤️

Smith said his mother, who passed away in February, would be proud: “I just know my mom is smiling down.”

(Via @atlantafalcons)
